title: Zesty German Long Bean Curry
description: A mustardy and tender German dish featuring long-bean, tadka, and kosher-friendly ingredients, perfect for adventurous eaters.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and add mustard seeds, letting them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add chopped onion and saute until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cut long beans, curry powder, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for 5 minutes, or until the long beans start to soften.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the curry simmer for 15 minutes, or until the long beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
